meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会写小脚本操作浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据、测试网页应用。页面状态在多次脚本执行之间保持,可以接着上一个页面继续操作。
howto.when: 当你要求打开某个网址、填写表单、截图等浏览器操作,或说出 “go to [url]”、“click on” 之类指令时,由它接管。

say.text: 打开 example.com,告诉我页面标题和地址
say.note: 会启动浏览器并返回标题与 URL

say.text: 登录我的账号后台,截一张当前页面
say.note: 扩展模式连接你已登录的 Chrome

say.text: 抓取这个列表页每条内容的标题和链接
say.note: 可改成拦截网络请求批量抓取

howto.what_en: Claude writes and runs small scripts to drive a browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape data, test web apps. Page state persists across script runs, so it can continue on the same pages.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any browser interaction request, such as "go to [url]", "click on" or "take a screenshot", or when you ask to scrape, automate or test a website.

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me its title and URL
say_en.note: Launches a browser, returns title and URL

say_en.text: Log into my account dashboard and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Uses extension mode on your logged-in Chrome

say_en.text: Scrape the titles and links of every item on this list page
say_en.note: Can switch to intercepting network requests
